examples.arabic: رحت انا وجدي عشان نتفرج على الماتش في الاستاد
examples.english: My grandfather and I went to watch the match at the stadium.
examples.transliteration: roht ana wa gedi ashan netfarag ala el matsh fi el estad

examples.arabic: الجو في الاستاد كان حلو اوي
examples.english: The atmosphere in the stadium was very nice.
examples.transliteration: El gaw fel estad kan helw awi

examples.arabic: الاستاد كان مليان ناس وصوت الجمهور كان عالي اوي
examples.english: The stadium was full of people and the crowd's sound was very loud.
examples.transliteration: El-estad kan malyan nas we sot el-gomhour kan 3ali awi.
examples.storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

examples.arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اروح الاستاد النهارده واشوف الماتش
examples.english: I just drove the car to go to the stadium today and watch the match.
examples.transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan arouh el estad ennaharda we ashouf el match.

examples.arabic: الناس كانت مالية الاستاد والكل بيقول اهلا وسهلا
examples.english: The stadium was full of people and everyone was saying 'welcome'.
examples.transliteration: El nas kanat malya el estad wal kol bi'ool ahlan wa sahlan

examples.english: I went to the stadium yesterday.
